description: Represents one condition of a saved filter.

disabled.description: If true, the condition is kept in the saved filter but not applied.
disabled.title: disabled

operator.description: How the attribute is compared with the values.
operator.title: operator

values.description: The values of the condition. Holds one value for single-value operators, the list for multi-value operators, and nothing for Exists and DoesNotExist. A relative time is stored as an object whose now key holds a duration such as -24h.
values.title: values
